sources.entry: POMjs - Random password generator. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 Javascript

summary.one_liner: POMjs is a small random password generator written in plain HTML and pure JavaScript, with no external resources, tracking, or cookies.
summary.what_it_does: It generates random passwords in the browser from selectable character sets: uppercase, lowercase, digits, a default special-character set, and an optional second special-character set. Password length is adjusted with a slider or an input field, with a configurable minimum and maximum. The generated password is shown with a strength indicator, and clicking it copies it to the clipboard. The interface uses a normalize.css reset and honors the browser's dark mode setting. Character sets, defaults, length limits, and the debug flag are changed by editing variables in the JavaScript file, and the UI strings are available in English, Swedish, German, Dutch, Finnish, French, and Luxembourgish, selected from the browser language.
use_cases: generate a random password in the browser
create strong passwords offline-style without external scripts
customize password character sets for a website
embed a password generator on a personal or company web page
how_to_run: Download the distribution or clone the repo: git clone https://github.com/joho1968/POMjs
Place the files and folders in your web root or another folder served by your web server
Open index.html in the served folder through a browser
Optionally edit password-om.js to change settings, then regenerate password-om.min.js
notable: No external resources, tracking code, or cookie management
Configurable character sets, default toggles, and length limits via variables in the JavaScript file
Translations for seven languages, chosen from navigator.language
Click the password to copy it to the clipboard
caveats: Customization requires editing the source; the README describes no configuration UI
The README mentions a Swedish site (Öppet Moln) in the installation and credits, which can be removed manually
